$Comment: The shared skeleton for boss contracts. The step counts boss fights two ways. A fight ziggfreed-common runs (an encounter script that shows a boss bar, or one a pack binds) credits every participant the fight counted, whoever landed the last hit, under the encounter SCRIPT id (the file name under Server/EncounterManager, never the boss creature's id, which changes when a fight swaps phases). A kill of a role ziggfreed-common's encounter rules name (Server/ZiggfreedCommon/EncounterRules: the Voidtaken Grizzly, the Skeleton Elite's second phase, a Feastmaster killed outside its own fight) credits the killer alone, under that role id. A child names one fight by either id, or leaves Target out to count any boss on the server. EXACT matching is deliberate: a script id is one exact name with no variants to catch. A child may also set Kind to ENCOUNTER_ATTEMPT, which counts fights fought to the end whether they were won or lost, so 'stand in it to the finish' and 'bring it down' are two different contracts. Nothing here names a board: that belongs to the child.
